roles.title: Business Development Associate
requirements: 0-3 years of experience (EdTech is a plus)
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Human Resources, or related field
Strong interest in cold calling and cold emailing
Proficiency (or willingness to learn) in LinkedIn and social media for networking
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
Experience in student placements or recruitment (preferred)
responsibilities: Generate leads for placements via cold calling, emailing, and LinkedIn outreach
Develop and maintain relationships with HR managers, recruiters, and decision-makers
Promote TAP Academy students’ skills to potential employers via LinkedIn and social media
Design and implement placement strategies aligned with industry needs and student qualifications
Conduct market research on hiring trends, skill demands, and networking opportunities
Track and report outreach activities, lead generation, and placement outcomes
